chapters.title: Shipping Cost Calculator UI and Architecture
Interface, Enum and Orchestrator Code Structure
Limitations of the Current Interface Model
Interface Extension Feature - Syntax and Benefits
Type Checking and Casting with Is and As Operators

features.name: Interface Extension
features.description: Allows you to create a new interface that extends an existing interface, enabling vendors to add new methods without breaking existing implementations. Implementors must implement all methods from all extended interfaces.
caveats: All implementors must implement all methods from all extended interfaces
Does not change existing enums so old implementations still work

features.name: Type Checking with Is Operator for Interfaces
features.description: A new Boolean expression that tests if an interface instance implements another interface. Can be used with interface variables, parameters, or variant types to check if a codeunit implements a specific interface.
caveats: Left side must be an instance of interface type or variant
Should check before casting to avoid errors

features.name: Interface Casting with As Operator
features.description: A new casting operator that converts an interface instance to a different interface type. Returns an interface of the type specified on the right side. Will error if the left side cannot be cast to the right side.
caveats: Will error if left side cannot be cast to right side
Should check with is operator first before casting

features.name: Unknown Interface Type
features.description: A new common base interface type added to the system application that can be used for generic functionality when checking whether an unknown interface implements a specific interface type.
